name: Robin DiPasquale
bio: Assistant Professor and anatomist for Clarkson's health sciences programs, teaching Human Anatomy for PT and OT students. Trained as an anthropologist, she taught Comparative Primate Anatomy at the University at Buffalo for seven years; her research in bioarchaeology and paleopathology uses skeletal evidence and isotope analysis to study health disparities in past populations, including fieldwork on medieval sites in Romania.
